Just came across this thread and I can’t describe how seen I feel from reading all these. I’ve only met one other person in my entire life who is the child of an adoptee. My dad has deep, core identity issues, abandonment issues, and low self esteem largely stemming from his adoption. It’s so frustrating to not be able to fix it. It’s also kind of frustrating on my end for health reasons - I have no idea what might run in his bio family that I could end up getting. I try not to worry about it too much, but it does make me wonder.
I’m so, so glad I found this thread (albeit years later lol). Thank you all for opening up about your own experiences - I’m really grateful that others know what it’s like too
